subject.title: Request analysis - Anthropic Admin provider: optional per-workspace spend breakdown

question: Should the Claude Admin provider add an opt-in workspace-spend detail surface, and should it be a capped/nested breakdown rather than one primary card per workspace?
rationale: Current behavior is intentional organization-level aggregation, while the proposal introduces both a new setting and a menu-density tradeoff that source inspection cannot resolve.

options.title: Approve a narrow opt-in breakdown
options.body: Add a default-off setting with a capped or nested workspace list, retaining the current organization total for single-workspace and disabled cases.

options.title: Keep organization-only aggregation
options.body: Decline the additional workspace surface and preserve the existing compact organization-level spend presentation.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow opt-in breakdown
recommendation.body: Add a default-off setting with a capped or nested workspace list, retaining the current organization total for single-workspace and disabled cases.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product-scope and menu UX decision rather than a mechanical correction to existing behavior.
